scripts.lint: rm -rf dist && node build.mjs && web-ext lint -s dist
scripts.package: yarn lint && web-ext build -s dist -a artifacts --overwrite-dest -n persistent-search-filters-{version}.zip
scripts.package-source: mkdir -p artifacts && rm -f artifacts/source.zip && python3 -m zipfile -c artifacts/source.zip README.md package.json yarn.lock tsconfig.json build.mjs src static assets
